Container.Name: BlindDrop-API
Container.Overview: Backend for BlindDrop, a zero-knowledge one-time secret sharing service. Keep the API behind a TLS reverse proxy and use a private authenticated Redis instance.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: API port; restrict host access to the TLS reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Redis URL
Config.Description: Authenticated Redis connection string. Use a URL-safe password and keep Redis off the public network.

Config.Name: Turnstile Secret Key
Config.Description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key for captcha verification.

Config.Name: Turnstile Allowed Hostnames
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames accepted in Turnstile verification responses.

Config.Name: Turnstile Action
Config.Description: Expected Cloudflare Turnstile action returned by the creation widget.

Config.Name: CORS Origin
Config.Description: Explicit frontend origin allowlist; comma-separated for multiple origins. Wildcard is not permitted in production.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy IPs
Config.Description: Comma-separated reverse-proxy addresses allowed to supply the client IP for rate limiting.

Config.Name: Node ENV
Config.Description: Set to 'production' for fail-closed security configuration.
